name: ZoroCoding
description: Local-first macOS AI coding desktop app with model routing, project tools, real progress tracking, and removable-drive storage. Designed for Apple Silicon Macs running from portable hard drive with encrypted API key storage.

name: Sixwhyo
description: AI code review agent that catches over-engineering, confusing names, and unnecessary complexity. Acts as a six-year-old reviewer asking 'why?' about everything to promote simplicity and readability.

name: AgentDoctor
description: Local CLI tool that audits AI coding agent configurations for security vulnerabilities, exposed environment files, private keys, MCP filesystem scopes, and context waste. Works with Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex environments without API keys.

name: CleanSlate
description: Open-source coding agent for IDE, CLI, and SDK environments. VS Code-based agent fork with Execution mode for building and Plan mode for read-only analysis, supporting multiple AI providers with 59 built-in tools.

name: agentacct
description: Local-first agent work intelligence dashboard that monitors coding agent activity. Reads session logs from Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode, displaying token usage, costs, work steps, and file changes with privacy-focused localhost architecture.

name: openhub
description: Keyboard-first terminal UI discovery hub and package installer for AI coding tools, skills, and agents. Features fuzzy search, curated collections, and universal skill export compatible with multiple AI coding environments.

name: Finn-loop
description: Three-skill AI software factory for Claude Code that integrates Linear and GitHub. Workflow: finn-spec interviews and files issues, finn-build implements and opens PRs, finn-review posts verdicts. Humans retain final merge authority.

name: DarkPs-Agent-CLI
description: Extensible local-first AI agent framework for project workspaces, developer tooling, and MCP integration. Features automatic workspace interpretation, self-registering tools, persistent memory, and support for both cloud and local models.

name: bbarit-agent-oss
description: Open-source AI coding agent CLI tool written in Rust, shipping as a single static binary. Supports 15+ LLM providers with 1,000+ models, semantic code search, 295 curated personas, project wiki, and auto-memory system.

name: BossConsole
description: Multi-platform harness for AI agents built with Kotlin running on JVM. Provides Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, and OpenCode with real tools including embedded browser, terminal, code editor, secrets management, and MCP automation.

name: sigbound
description: Tool for running multiple AI coding agents on one repository in parallel with automatic merging. Lands only changes that build and pass tests, addressing the 30-50% time developers spend on conflict resolution with parallel agents.

name: chartr
description: Agent multiplexer combining terminal multiplexing with visual work mapping. Renders plans as star-maps and enables launching planning agents, spawning sessions from tickets, and automatic detection of agent CLIs.

name: open-kritt
description: Open-source, self-hosted security research platform that orchestrates AI agents to find real vulnerabilities in code. Breaks security research into small tasks, runs them across AI agents in parallel, and validates findings with proof of concepts.
